question: does the fibre reading of conj:im-q-physical-role open route 5, and what does the Kashaev regime supply?
answer: yes, and exactly: det A = -(ln q)^2 > 0 iff |q| = 1, so the unit circle is the whole locus on which the step-18/19 exclusion lifts -- and it is the same locus candidate (i) names. The root-of-unity sublocus needs theta/2pi rational, which no measurement decides; k/N = 1/111 is the only low-denominator candidate and sits inside the target's own 4.0e-4 uncertainty, so it is neither excluded nor evidence.
scope: (a) for the arithmetic; the ellipticity criterion is an identity

assertions.name: unit_circle_is_exactly_where_the_exclusion_lifts
assertions.detail: det A = -(ln q)^2 is positive iff ln q is purely imaginary iff |q| = 1; at the real anchor det A = -0.010886986 < 0 (hyperbolic, the step-18 exclusion) and on the circle det A = +phi^2 > 0 (elliptic). The fibre locus is not one candidate among many -- it is the whole solution set.

assertions.name: ellipticity_locus_coincides_with_candidate_i_locus
assertions.detail: the ellipticity requirement (this probe) and the chirality identification (candidate (i)) select the SAME locus |q| = 1 from independent directions -- recorded as a structural correspondence, not as evidence for either

assertions.name: only_N_111_is_inside_the_targets_own_uncertainty
assertions.detail: k/N = 1/111 sits 0.0002124 relative from the required phase, INSIDE the target's own 0.0004 band, so it cannot be excluded -- and equally is not evidence. Larger denominators fit better and mean nothing: a denominator is a free parameter. No search for a reason N should be 111 was run.

assertions.name: rationality_is_not_decidable_by_measurement
assertions.detail: a root of unity supplies theta iff theta/2pi is rational; every real number has rational approximations of arbitrary accuracy, so no measurement settles this. The convergents illustrate the point rather than answering it.

assertions.name: coincidence_is_recorded_not_pursued
assertions.detail: 2pi/theta and 100*q_0 agree to 0.0001932 relative; an integer index against a dimensionless modulus with a hand-inserted factor of 100. Recorded so a later reader does not rediscover it as new.
